description: Area of a site in acres, hectares, square feet and square metres, plus its perimeter. Pass a polygon (from a county parcel map, a deed plan or a drawing) for an exact figure, or just an address or lat and lon to measure the OpenStreetMap outline of the place at that point (for example a campground, marina or hotel grounds). An OpenStreetMap outline is not a legal boundary: say "about" and check it against the deed.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

polygon.description: Optional. A GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature holding one), or a plain list of [lon, lat] points. Up to 5,000 points.

name: plot_size
title: Site or plot size
